ruler_question.question: What total amount of financing commitments and capacity backstops to customers and partners will NVIDIA report outstanding at its FY2027 year-end?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: The reported total is below $5 billion.

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: The reported total is at least $5 billion and below $10 billion.

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: The reported total is at least $10 billion and below $20 billion.

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: The reported total is at least $20 billion and below $40 billion.

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: The reported total is at least $40 billion.

judged_question.question: At NVIDIA's FY2027 annual report, what amount will NVIDIA report for its outstanding customer data-center lease guarantees and related capacity-purchase commitments?
judged_question.looks_at: NVIDIA's credit-support and capacity-purchase commitments to customers, including the revenue-sharing and credit-support program

judged_rungs.label: Bullish
judged_rungs.condition: The reported amount is at least $3,500,000,000 and below $6,300,000,000.

judged_rungs.label: Neutral
judged_rungs.condition: The reported amount is at least $6,300,000,000 and below $10,000,000,000.

judged_rungs.label: Bearish
judged_rungs.condition: The reported amount is at least $10,000,000,000 and below $20,000,000,000.

judged_rungs.label: Strongly bearish
judged_rungs.condition: The reported amount is at least $20,000,000,000.
